title: Sort an array using one explicit loop
answer: Yes, an array can be sorted with only one explicit loop, but that does not mean the algorithm becomes O(n). A gnome-sort-style approach uses one `while` loop and moves the index forward when adjacent values are ordered, or swaps them and moves backward when they are not. This eventually sorts the array but can take O(n²) time in the worst case. In production code I would normally prefer `Arrays.sort` unless the interview specifically asks for a one-loop implementation.
